analyst.summary: Whirlpool India's appliance business has seen sales stagnate and profit decline over the past year, in a competitive market where Indian and other multinational appliance makers are all fighting for share. The US parent has also been steadily reducing its ownership stake over the past three years, from 75% to under 40%, which is worth watching as a signal of long-term commitment. The balance sheet is clean, but growth and profitability trends do not currently support the stock's valuation.
